selection_note: Eighth full five-source nonduplicated assessment intake after all 35 prior rows were given bounded dispositions. Select licensed first-party Python systems from exactly pinned included S1=A Index records, with three reviewed 2026-10-20 and two reviewed 2026-10-19. Freeze upstream revisions and screening order before inspecting patch feasibility; all questions remain unproven. Use native deterministic first-party script/unit tests only: no LLM agent, mock-model task run, inference provider, simulated swarm or live deployment test. Human retains external upstream publication rights.

candidates.finding: Spartan persists cognitive and file-watcher state across model and process restarts. Screen first-party Python archive/recovery/serialization helpers for reproducible malformed, duplicate or interrupted state transitions with offline native-script inputs, excluding a live cognitive loop, local model or host machine actions.

Cyber AI Team has first-party owner authorization and action-policy decisions around business-domain work. Screen pure Python policy validators and transition guards with fixed inputs only; exclude ERPNext, PostgreSQL, Temporal company cycles, LLM agents, simulated model plans or any external business actions.

OniRoute ships first-party Python workspace governance, quality and validation modules around engineering artifacts. Screen deterministic validator and path-boundary handling on pinned real source using fixed local fixtures, not its model-backed engineering runner or simulated swarm-wave subsystem.

Active Graph has a first-party Python event log, typed graph patches and optimistic conflict checks. Screen script-only event-patch validation and replay invariants using genuine modules and fixed input events; do not invoke recorded, mocked or live LLM-backed goal behaviors.

PyFlue exposes first-party Python session/toolkit and sandbox policies over optional external backends. Screen deterministic tool and output-schema admission plus sandbox boundary checks against real native functions, never run backend agents, PydanticAI inference, simulated provider sessions or hosted services.
